title: In Progress® Telerik® Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027, uncontrolled recursion, infinite…
description: In Progress Telerik Document Processing Libraries prior to version 2026.3.1027 contain vulnerabilities involving uncontrolled recursion, infinite loops, unchecked loop conditions, and inefficient regular expressions in RadSpreadProcessing and RadSpreadStreamProcessing components. These flaws allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause denial of service by terminating or hanging the host process via crafted XLSX or XLS workbooks or formulas.
